requirement: Implement a small LangGraph-like state graph whose compile step rejects broken wiring and whose runtime stops runaway loops, so agent workflows fail fast instead of hanging.
skeleton: START and END sentinels, GraphError and GraphRecursionError, a StateGraph with add_node, add_edge, add_conditional_edges and a validating compile, and a CompiledGraph that merges partial updates and enforces a recursion limit.
caption: A LangGraph-style StateGraph builder written in the standard library with collections.abc Callable and typing Any and no third-party imports. GraphError subclasses ValueError and GraphRecursionError subclasses RuntimeError. add_node raises GraphError for START, END or a duplicate name; add_edge and add_conditional_edges record routes, the latter with a router and a copied path_map. compile raises GraphError for any plain or conditional edge touching an unknown node or leaving END, when START has no edge, or when a node has no outgoing route. invoke copies the state, merges each node's partial update into a new dict, follows the router through path_map raising GraphError on an unknown key, and raises GraphRecursionError once steps exceed recursion_limit. The fixture asserts the loop trace, an unmutated input, the exact recursion boundary, unknown router keys, and each compile-time rejection.

plan.intent: Wire an agent loop safely before running it
constraints: Reserved or duplicate node names raise GraphError
compile raises GraphError for edges to unknown nodes, including conditional targets
A graph without an entry edge or with a dead-end node raises GraphError
An unknown router key raises GraphError
More than recursion_limit steps raises GraphRecursionError
The caller's state is never mutated

rationale.teaches: Validate the whole graph once in compile, look router results up in an explicit path_map, and count node executions against recursion_limit.
rationale.why: Unchecked wiring fails deep inside a run with KeyError, and loops without a step budget spin forever or mutate shared state.

ops.docstring: A LangGraph-style graph builder that validates edges when compiled.

ops.source:
class GraphError(ValueError):
    """Raised when the graph structure is invalid."""

class GraphRecursionError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when a run takes more steps than the recursion limit."""

candidates.why_wrong: A run needing exactly recursion_limit steps is aborted as a recursion error.
An unknown router key surfaces as a bare KeyError instead of GraphError.
Conditional edges to nonexistent nodes compile and only fail during a run.
Node updates are written into the caller's dict, mutating the input state.
A node with no outgoing route compiles and crashes the run with KeyError.
